# Claudia CLI power user

**Every claudia command that matters, --json scripting, exit codes, watch + notify, the agent loop and money-safe defaults.**

Drives the claudia command line (@useclaudia/cli) like an expert — login and doctor, keys and config, coin insights, holders with wallet tags, KOL / smart-money / signal / trending feeds, live watch streams with Telegram, Discord or webhook notifications, the agent chat on the person's own model key, the thread posting loop, media generation, social posting, MCP install for 13 apps, and capped Solana quotes, buys, sells and launches. Covers --json scripting, exit codes, jq recipes, cron-safe usage and safety caps. Use when someone wants terminal workflows, shell scripts or cron jobs around Claudia, or asks how a claudia command or flag works.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/cli-power-user.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/cli-power-user.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/cli-power-user.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/cli-power-user.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill cli-power-user`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `cli-power-user.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/cli-power-user`.
